# Peak Hiring Weekly Review 2026-10-20

Tuesday peak review: [[conrad-baptiste]], [[marek-zielinski]], [[chiara-lombardi-ross]], the four hub managers and me.

## Position

214 of 260 hired, 128 direct and 86 agency; 191 inducted; 46 still needed, 18 at Hub North and 16 at Hub West ([[peak-hiring-tracker-2026]]). Hires have slowed to about 17 a week. At that rate we reach about 260 only by the last possible week, with no margin for drop-outs.

## Discussion

- Chiara can supply up to 40 more agency workers at five working days' notice.
- Marek wants to keep direct hiring open to 2026-11-06 to protect the 60/40 split.
- Hub West's room limits sessions to 32; [[maeve-donnelly]] offered spare Hub East places on Mondays for Hub West starters, but the travel between hubs is long.
- A Saturday induction on 2026-11-14 was suggested for the final intake ([[should-induction-run-on-saturdays-during-peak]]).

## Decisions and actions

- Conrad asked me and Marek for a shortfall plan by 2026-11-03: how many by agency, how many direct, and whether to lower the target.
- Direct hiring stays open until 2026-11-06.
- I check whether trainers would work a Saturday.
